name: JMH Woodcraft Inc
old_description: New York City's Premier Custom Carpentry Design and Building Specialists
about:
Founded in 1926 in New York City, JMH Woodcraft Inc. has operated as a custom carpentry and cabinetmaking shop for nearly a century. The company serves the five boroughs from its Manhattan base, offering design, fabrication, and installation for residential and commercial projects.

The shop produces custom carpentry pieces including kitchen islands, built-in bookcases, radiator covers, wall units, and entertainment centers. Its capabilities span solid-wood construction, stain matching, customized molding, antique restoration, total design integration, expert installation, and painting and repair. As a small firm, JMH Woodcraft emphasizes personalized attention on projects of any scale, from single built-ins to full commercial fit-outs.

Clients range from homeowners to institutional and commercial accounts. Recent commercial projects include work for Mount Sinai School of Medicine, Christ and St. Stephens Church, V&T's Restaurant, Firehouse Restaurant, Manhattan School for Children, Booker T. Washington Jr. High School, Beacon High School, and The Hungarian Pastry Shop. The company also serves residential customers throughout New York City.

JMH Woodcraft cites its small size as a key advantage, allowing personalized service on even the smallest jobs that larger contractors cannot accommodate. The firm highlights its reputation for craftsmanship, attention to detail, clear communication, honesty, and integrity, backed by a long list of satisfied clients and a standing offer of free consultations.
